<section class="wrap page-head">
<p class="overline">Blog</p>
<h1>Statistical analyses and write-ups</h1>
<p class="lead">Applied statistical analyses written up in R Markdown and published on RPubs, covering survival analysis, regression, multivariate methods, and classification. Each entry gives the main finding; click a title for the full report.</p>


</section>
<section class="wrap page-body"><ul class="news">
<li><span class="news-date">Dec 8, 2025</span><span><a href="https://rpubs.com/BaidooHub/1377993" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Hazard Ratio Blocks: Surgery vs. No Surgery by Age, Tumor Size, and Nodal Status in a SEER Cox Model (3D Visualization)</a><span class="post-sum">Interactive 3D plot of Cox-model hazard ratios for surgery versus no surgery across 27 age, tumor-size, and lymph-node subgroups; surgery is associated with a lower hazard in every subgroup (HR about 0.25&ndash;0.68).</span></span></li>
<li><span class="news-date">Jun 21, 2025</span><span><a href="https://rpubs.com/BaidooHub/1324436" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Analysis of Political Tolerance Among Faculty Ranks: An Analysis of Covariance Approach</a><span class="post-sum">ANCOVA shows that faculty rank modifies how political tolerance changes with age: full professors become less tolerant with age, while junior faculty remain stable.</span></span></li>
<li><span class="news-date">Jun 21, 2025</span><span><a href="https://rpubs.com/BaidooHub/1324328" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Determinants of Pulse Rate Variability in Response to Acute Physical Activity: An Analysis of Classroom Experiment Data</a><span class="post-sum">Stratified regression of classroom experiment data on 112 students: running raised pulse by about 51 bpm while sitting caused almost no change, and activity type, not individual characteristics, drove the response.</span></span></li>
<li><span class="news-date">Jun 21, 2025</span><span><a href="https://rpubs.com/BaidooHub/1324320" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Determinants of Sleep Duration in the American Time Use Survey</a><span class="post-sum">Linear regression with AIC-based stepwise selection on ATUS data (2003&ndash;2021): sleep duration is associated with age, sex, education, work hours, household composition, and an interaction between time alone and time with family.</span></span></li>
<li><span class="news-date">Jun 21, 2025</span><span><a href="https://rpubs.com/BaidooHub/1324288" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Classification of Wild Razorback Sucker Origins Using PCA and Logistic Regression</a><span class="post-sum">PCA and logistic regression on stable isotopes classify Razorback Sucker habitats with about 70% accuracy, supporting conservation efforts.</span></span></li>
<li><span class="news-date">Jun 21, 2025</span><span><a href="https://rpubs.com/BaidooHub/1324270" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Classification of Razorback Sucker Origins Using Stable Isotope Ratios and Discriminant Analysis</a><span class="post-sum">Quadratic discriminant analysis of fin ray isotopes classifies hatchery versus wild Razorback Suckers with 87&ndash;90% accuracy, a non-lethal tool for conservation monitoring.</span></span></li>
<li><span class="news-date">Jun 20, 2025</span><span><a href="https://rpubs.com/BaidooHub/1324057" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Predicting Endemic Plant Proportions in the Galapagos Islands Using Logistic Regression</a><span class="post-sum">Logistic regression shows how island area and isolation influence the proportion of endemic plants, with mixed predictive performance across islands.</span></span></li>
<li><span class="news-date">Jun 20, 2025</span><span><a href="https://rpubs.com/BaidooHub/1324052" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Principal Components Analysis of New Mexico County-Level Poverty and Housing Characteristics</a><span class="post-sum">PCA reduces 13 county-level poverty and housing variables to 3 interpretable components, revealing the main patterns across New Mexico counties.</span></span></li>
<li><span class="news-date">Jun 20, 2025</span><span><a href="https://rpubs.com/BaidooHub/1324051" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Principal Components Analysis of Prehistoric Goblets from Thailand</a><span class="post-sum">PCA of 25 prehistoric Thai goblets identifies size as the main source of variation, with secondary components capturing differences in shape.</span></span></li>
<li><span class="news-date">Jun 4, 2025</span><span><a href="https://rpubs.com/BaidooHub/1318391" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Isotopic Clustering Analysis of San Juan River Razorback Suckers</a><span class="post-sum">Isotopic clustering distinguishes hatchery-raised from wild Razorback Suckers in the San Juan River to support fisheries management.</span></span></li>
</ul></section>
